title: Boss Challenge: The Great Bengaluru Race
summary: A metro, a car, an auto and a cyclist race from Majestic to Whitefield. Read their distance–time graph to find out what really happened.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: processing data from graphs (Criterion C) and impacts of transport (Criterion D)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 8: Measurement of Time and Motion

objectives: I can extract information from a distance–time graph with several lines.
I can calculate average speed from graph data, with unit conversion.
I can compare modes of transport using evidence.
misconceptions: The fastest vehicle at one moment always arrives first.
Stops don't count when calculating average speed.
